FORT[...], probably FORTIS or FORTIS I for the maker

Fragment of Roman ceramic oil lamp AD.43-410. This is part of the base and side of a ceramic lamp, with a moulded inscription within a circular depression. The inscription reads FORT[...], probably FORTIS or FORTIS I for the maker. The lamp is made from an oxidised red/brown terracotta ceramic. The interior is undecorated and the exterior surface retains some striations from where it has been…
